verdict.rationale: Algolia is a hosted SaaS that stores customer data and ships ML/AI features (NeuralSearch, Recommend, Agent Studio), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers data-usage policies, model-training opt-outs, or controls that keep indexed data out of AI training. Bring-your-own-LLM and completion caching in Agent Studio do not address this.
